sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.content: The total sales performance for the period of 2026-01-05 to 2026-02-28 resulted in a net revenue of $2,945.00 across 15 orders and 87 units sold. The business achieved a net profit of $1,525.50, representing a gross margin of 51.8%.
The top-performing products by revenue are: 1. USB-C Hub ($640 revenue, 21.73% share), 2. Gaming Headset ($480 revenue, 16.3% share), and 3. Mechanical Keyboard ($480 revenue, 16.3% share).
